request: Owner, 2026-11-05: "Printify we should improvise on new designs and find the most selling ones"
our_sales_signal: None yet. Printify shows 0 orders since the shop opened (weekly reviews Oct 26 and Nov 2), so there is no in-shop data on what sells. Etsy views and favorites are only in the owner's Etsy Shop Manager, which is blocked from our sessions.
market_signal: eRank Trend Buzz: 'christmas' is the top keyword on Etsy, monthly searches rising from 4,730 (Feb 2026) to 76,880 (Oct 2026); about 119K in Nov 2025. eRank's summer report says it peaks in November.
eRank Q3 2026: 'christmas' climbed to #9 from #41 a year earlier; 'christmas ornament' was among the fastest climbers in the September snapshot (from #114).
eRank 2026 holiday trends: heritage tartan, velvet, dark wood; trend searches include 'burgundy christmas ornament', 'gold christmas decor', 'farmhouse christmas decor'.

Teeinblue's 2026 guide (vendor blog, not Etsy data): ornaments are the top-selling POD Christmas product, then wall art, mugs, plaques, stockings, apparel. Personalized ornaments lead, which we can't do yet (per-order art).
Bookish holiday sweatshirts are a steady category (Book Riot roundups 2023-2024; Kohl's and Walmart book-tree sweatshirts).
The red truck with a Christmas tree is one of the most-listed Christmas designs (Walmart, Faire, eBay), mostly with the 'Farm Fresh Christmas Trees' sign phrase.
limits: WebFetch is blocked from our sessions, so these come from search-result summaries, not full pages. None of them is Etsy's own sales data.
